messages:
alex_stratisea: Hi team — Procurement at Stratisea says they will not accept any vendor invoice unless a PO is on file. We need an invoice for Q4 usage but don't have a PO yet. Can you generate something the procurement team can use to create a PO (proforma, quote, etc.)?

maxine_support: Hey @alex_stratisea — we can help. Do they require the PO number to be printed on the invoice before payment, or will a proforma/quote suffice for internal PO creation?

alex_stratisea: They explicitly said "no payment without PO". They need a proforma to create the PO. It usually takes 7–10 business days to get the PO number assigned. Also procurement wants vendor tax docs and the legal invoice name. 

julia_billing: Understood. For Enterprise accounts we usually either 1) accept card payment now, or 2) provide a proforma invoice for procurement. If they require the invoice to have the PO number we can't issue a final payable invoice until we get it. :thinking:

oliver_accountexec: If Stratisea can pay by card and wants immediate access, that's a workaround. Otherwise we should prepare a proforma addressed exactly as they need and include the note 'Not a demand for payment'. @julia_billing can Billing produce that quickly?

julia_billing: Yes — I can draft a proforma. Need the exact billing name, VAT ID, billing address, and the billing contact email. Also confirm the total and line items you want shown.

alex_stratisea: Billing name must be: "Stratisea Medical GmbH". VAT: DE123456789. Billing email: finance@stratisea.de. Please list: Redwood API usage, Dedicated Reserved Capacity, and Support. Amount should match last month's usage (~€24,350). Also they want net and gross breakdown for VAT reclaim.

maxine_support: Thanks. I'll open a billing ops ticket and tag the account PO_PENDING. @julia_billing — once proforma is ready can you cc procurement@stratisea.de so they have what they need to create the PO?

julia_billing: Creating proforma now. Draft template:

```
Proforma Invoice (for procurement purposes only)
Customer: Stratisea Medical GmbH
VAT: DE123456789
Billing address: [awaiting full address]
Invoice for: Redwood API usage + Dedicated Reserved Capacity + Support
Total (Gross): €24,350.00
Note: "This document is a proforma invoice for procurement purposes only. This is not a demand for payment. Final invoice will be issued upon receipt of official Purchase Order."
```

I'll attach net/gross breakdown and CC finance email. Also including standard vendor tax docs link: <https://redwood.example.com/tax-docs>

oliver_accountexec: I'll ping the procurement contact to nudge for expedited PO. If this drags beyond 10 business days we can escalate to offer a short-term credit hold so service isn't interrupted.

alex_stratisea: Thanks — please make sure the proforma includes an "Order reference" field that procurement can populate with the PO number once issued (leave blank for now).

julia_billing: Will do. Also note: per EU VAT rules we need billing country confirmation — Alex, billing country?

alex_stratisea: Germany.

maxine_support: All set on our side. I flagged the account and added instructions for procurement to email billing@redwood.com with subject 'PO for Stratisea — PO12345' once they have it. Keeping this thread pinned for updates. :white_check_mark:

[~1 hour later]

alex_stratisea: Update from procurement — we got the PO: PO-STR-2026-77. I just forwarded it to billing. Thanks for the quick proforma.

julia_billing: Received PO and issued final invoice against PO-STR-2026-77. Sent to finance@stratisea.de and cc'd account exec. Account hold cleared. Invoice #INV-2026-09123. Payment scheduled per PO terms.

maxine_support: Great — closing the loop. If anything else comes up ping this thread. :rocket:
